Portfolio

Paloma Elesser is a trailblazing supermodel who first rose to fame after being hand-selected by beauty maven Pat McGrath to feature in her namesake beauty line, Pat McGrath Labs. Since, Elsesser has gone on to grace the covers of global magazines including i-D, Puss Puss, 10 Magazine, Unconditional, Muse, and multiple international Vogue editions. She has starred in major brand campaigns for Balenciaga, Victoria’s Secret, Supreme, Marc Jacobs, Fara Homidi, Coach, Ferragamo, and Marni and walked for Michael Kors, Tory Burch, Fendi, Burberry, Alexander McQueen, and more. Elesser has established herself as a leading voice in the industry and is an outspoken advocate for body acceptance and mental health awareness. She spoke at Vogue’s Forces of Fashion conference and continues to push the envelope in her role as a global contributing editor to i-D magazine and host of their chat show, The Squeeze. Paloma also holds an esteemed position as part of the selection committee for the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund. Elesser was a 2024 Models.com “Model of the Year” nominee and was recently deemed one of “The New Supers” by British Vogue.
